title: upgrade-attn-flashattnv2-rope-fused-rotary-kv-batching-scheduling
author: Maya Patel
description: Upgrade attention kernels to the FlashAttentionV2 variant with fused QKV ops and additional rotary/rope compatibility, add scheduling hooks for continuous batching and KV-cache streaming optimizations. Motivation: reduce per-token decode latency and increase throughput under mixed sequence-length workloads. This change introduces a new fused_qkv kernel (FA2 variant), a rotary-aware rotary_rope shim to support both rotary and rope position encodings, and scheduler integration for slot-based continuous batching and KV eviction hints. The PR includes microbenchmarks showing 12-18% median latency improvement on decode for 8k-context models and up to 25% throughput gains at high concurrency. Backwards compatibility: runtime falls back to legacy kernels for unsupported devices or when kernel compilation fails. Includes unit, integration and perf tests and a migration note for model owners.
